name: markdown-accept-extensions
body: The markdown frontend must accept exactly the markdown extension set `.md` and `.markdown` (DECIDED; `.mdx` is OUT — it is JSX-embedded and not the markdown frontend's concern, at most a later feature). For each accepted file it emits a File node whose FQN is the absolute path, extension retained — never dropping the file (all-code-included: filtering is by code_type, not by omission) — and a shared Module node for the file's directory — FQN = `<language-root>.` + the directory's absolute path (`md.<directory-absolute-path>`, the path-derived collision-free module identity, see markdown-sections-as-symbols), i.e. one Module per directory rather than one per file. AC: a repo containing .md and .markdown files produces exactly one File node per accepted file (FQN = the file's absolute path, extension retained) and exactly one Module node per directory holding accepted files (FQN = `md.<directory absolute path>`, shared by every markdown file in that directory) — two markdown files in the same directory share a single Module and are two distinct File nodes; no accepted file is absent from the graph; a `.mdx` file produces no markdown node (not accepted by the markdown frontend).
